remarks: Welcome to 19 Oriole Drive, a meticulously maintained 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home set on a spacious 0.75-acre lot. It effortlessly combines modern updates, timeless style, and everyday comfort. Inside, enjoy a newly renovated kitchen and half bath with sleek, contemporary finishes.  A new A/C unit installed for the main floor and efficient two-zone heating and cooling provides year-round comfort, while wood floors throughout add warmth and charm.  Step outside to enjoy the screened-in porch, large patio area, in-ground pool, and a brand-new shed, providing extra storage for all your outdoor gear and seasonal items.  The large driveway also includes a brand-new basketball hoop, ideal for outdoor recreation, and room for plenty of parking. The roof, just 8 years old, provides peace of mind for years to come.  Ideally located in a convenient and walkable neighborhood, the home is just a short walk to local schools and minutes from popular shopping, including Stew Leonard's, restaurants, and major commuter routes.   Move-in ready and thoughtfully updated, this home offers the perfect combination of modern upgrades, comfort, and convenience in one of Norwalk's most accessible locations. Agent related to seller.
